drew_sales: Quick warm handoff - Silverpine Therapeutics closed for $95k ARR. Go-live target ~4w. Requirements: Okta SSO + SCIM, private VPC with EU residency, reserved capacity for peak inference, and enhanced audit logs. Renewal in ~10 months. SOW: https://redwood.co/sow/SIL-2026-03 :point_up:

maria_cs: Ill take the lead. Clarify: reserved pools only during daytime bursts or full 24/7 dedicated? Any compliance docs beyond SOC2?

drew_sales: They want 24/7 dedicated pools for predictability. Compliance: SOC2 + GDPR data residency + request for detailed audit log retention (12 months). Main contact: jules@silverpine.example, +44 7700 900111. Provisioning window: week of May 4.

maria_cs: Owners: Maria (CS lead/onboarding), Lee (Support/Infra) SSO & VPC, Celine (CS Ops) renewal tracking & enablement. Ill spin up the onboarding workspace and draft success milestones (prod by May 12).

lee_support: Ill own Okta + SCIM + peering. Need Okta metadata, SCIM provisioning token, and Silverpine VPC CIDRs. Creating infra ticket now.

lee_support: /ticket create --team=infra --priority=P2 --desc="Silverpine Okta/SCIM + VPC peering for private deploy" --owner=lee_support

reminder-bot: Meeting scheduled: Silverpine Kickoff  May 5 09:30 UTC (maria_cs, lee_support, celine_ops, drew_sales). Invite sent.

celine_ops: Ill set renewal play: trigger QBRs at month 5, track TTV, latency SLO, monthly token spend, and feature adoption (batch embeddings + streaming chat). Ill also prepare an enablement checklist and a 3-week feedback form.

maria_cs: Noted blocker: Silverpine has a maintenance freeze May 10-13. We should aim to finish peering before freeze or schedule maintenance otherwise.

drew_sales: Silverpine confirmed peering window May 6-8. Looks safe.

lee_support: Ill target May 6 for peering. Draft config steps:
```
- Gather Okta metadata XML & SCIM token
- Exchange VPC CIDRs and allowed ports
- Configure peering + route propagation
- Run connectivity smoke tests against private endpoint
- Verify audit log shipping & retention settings
```

maria_cs: CS next items: 1) 30-min internal pre-kickoff (maria_cs + celine_ops + drew_sales) to review SOW + compliance needs, 2) include 1-page roadmap for the features they purchased, 3) schedule product enablement 1 week before go-live.

celine_ops: Also request they rank priority: auditability vs latency vs cost on the kickoff form to tune Optimize recommendations.

lee_support: Created ticket INF-7901 and linked onboarding workspace. Will post final peering plan and expected downtime (<20min) there. Tag me for a test account.

maria_cs: Thanks. Ill post the onboarding workspace link and assign tasks today. If legal produces a data residency addendum, please attach to the workspace.

drew_sales: Ill follow up with their security contact to expedite SCIM token. Ping me if anything blocks before May 5. :thumbsup:

reminder-bot: Reminder: Pre-kickoff internal sync in 24 hours.

maria_cs: Pre-kickoff done  workspace: https://redwood.co/onboard/silverpine-workspace. Owners assigned; will update after kickoff. :rocket:
